name: Taiwan monthly operating revenue announcement on MOPS (Securities and Exchange Act Art. 36 and SFC orders)
requirements: TWSE/TPEx-listed companies input consolidated monthly operating revenue into MOPS before the 10th day of the following month [@c_tw_monthly_rev]; quarterly reports within 45 days [@c_tw_quarterly]; annual within 3 months [@c_tw_annual].
operational_impact: Gives a monthly, company-level revenue series for all Taiwan-listed chip firms; basis of MOPS industry revenue tables.

name: CSRC Regulations on Information Disclosure of Listed Companies (2007)
requirements: Annual report within 4 months, interim within 2 months, quarterly within 1 month [@c_cn_periodic]; disclosure in Chinese via CSRC-appointed media first [@c_cn_chinese].
penalties: Punishment under Article 193 of the Securities Law for late, false or misleading disclosure.

name: HKEX Main Board Listing Rule 13.46 (distribution of annual report)
authority: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing (Stock Exchange of Hong Kong)
requirements: Annual report within four months of year-end; English with Chinese translation [@c_hk_annual].

name: Abolition of quarterly securities reports under the 2023 amendment to Japan's Financial Instruments and Exchange Act
requirements: Listed companies file a half-year report instead of quarterly securities reports; deadline 45 days (60 days for some) [@c_jp_quarterly_abolished].
